ComplianceSummary.//: Background job that recomputes the per-company compliance summary the company detail panel shows. Set IntervalMinutes to 0 to stop it; the panel then shows whatever was last written.

MailDelivery.//: Background worker that drains the outgoing mail queue. Harmless when no organization has configured an account: it finds nothing to send. Set Enabled to false to stop it entirely.

DocumentStorage.//: Root for stored document payloads. Keep it OUTSIDE the web root: anything the web server can serve directly bypasses every permission check. A relative path is resolved against the content root.

ConnectionStrings.//: Production baseline. The database is EnsaDb - no environment suffix; the development database is EnsaDbDEv. Override the whole string at deployment with the ConnectionStrings__Default environment variable or a key vault: a credential committed here is a published credential, and this repository is public. Shape for the live server: Server=<host>,1433;Database=EnsaDb;User Id=<user>;Password=<from the environment>;Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True;Connection Timeout=30;

Auth.//: Development only. Allows tokens to be issued over plain HTTP.

Encryption.//: AES-256 for the encrypted columns (national ids). Key = 32 bytes base64, Iv = 16 bytes base64. DELIBERATELY EMPTY: a key in source control is a published key. Development falls back to a fixed development value; every other environment refuses to start until you set Encryption__Key and Encryption__Iv through environment variables, user-secrets or a key vault. Generate a pair with: dotnet run --project src/Ensa.DbMigrator -- --new-encryption-key

AutoMapper.//: AutoMapper 15+ commercial licence key. Left empty, the community limits apply.
